João Feres Júnior is a Full Professor of Political Science at IESP–UERJ, where he has taught since 2010, and holds a PhD from the City University of New York. He coordinates INCT ID-ICED, GEMAA, the Brazilian Legislative Observatory and LEMEP, the laboratory responsible for Manchetômetro. His research covers political communication, political behavior, democratic theory, affirmative action, race relations and conceptual history. He is the author of Nas ruas e fora delas: Junho de 2013 revisitado (Autêntica, 2026).

Contact: jferes@iesp.uerj.br
Source: author-supplied Lattes CV, updated 16 November 2026; book details from Autêntica; INCT ID-ICED website.
